name: JobGroupWait
description: help-while-waiting join (181 callers): while ([g+34h] > 1) JobHelpStep(g->owner, g, &wakeFlag=1, mode or 2 after 0x4000 polls); then lock dec [g+34h]. J1 rows 3E7F5/3E821

name: JobPushToOwner

name: JobWorkerRunUntilIdle
description: worker body after each wake: steal ONE job from the other workers (411C0, w+1..), then 40800 pops with wakeFlag=1 (each woken worker wakes one more = cascade), one last steal scan, return (no spin before sleeping)

name: JobHelpStepWrapper
description: calls JobHelpStep 403A0 (6 callers)

name: JobHelpStep
signature: void JobHelpStep(JobWorker* w, JobGroup* g, u8* wakeFlag, int mode)
description: one poll of a job wait: pop/run own queue (40800), re-push deferred jobs, steal one job from the other workers (411C0); if nothing and !(w+454h & 1) -> Sleep(0) at 404B9

name: JobHelpStep_Sleep0
description: the job-wait Sleep(0) (candidate Y1, not built): 0 % of [App]Game, <=1.4 % of KIDSTaskScheduler0 in r5

name: JobWorkerPoll_WakeDecision
description: wake decision after a successful pop: wake iff *wakeFlag or (all other workers idle && ++w[450h] % 30 == 0); idle count = pool+30h

name: JobWorkerPoll_WakeBlock
description: start of the wake-one block (scan downward from w-1 for a worker whose thread+10h bit0 is set, CAS-clear it, SetEvent); WK patch site (call caveWakeGate)

name: JobWorkerPoll_SetEvent
description: the per-pop wake syscall (KERNEL32 SetEvent on thread+8)

name: JobWorkerPoll_WakeBlockEnd
description: *wakeFlag = 0 (sil=0); WK skip target

name: JobWorkerPoll_SetEvent2
description: second wake-one site: job type 616FA0 when pool+34h != 0, followed by JobWaitSleepBackoff 207200

name: JobPushLocal
description: push onto worker w's own queue + set priority bit; used for continuations (group counter hit 0) (16 callers). No wake

name: JobForwardToWorker
description: forwards a job whose worker mask (job+22h) excludes the current worker to a specific worker and SetEvents it

name: KtglSignalUntilAwake

name: KtglSignalUntilAwake2
description: same idiom as 3EB38 on [x+5C8h]; else spins on byte x+5F8h with Sleep(0) every 256

name: JobWorkerThreadMain

name: JobWorkerThreadMain_SetSleepBit
description: CAS sets thread+10h bit0 = "sleeping, wake me" before the INFINITE wait at 1A6BC35

name: KidsSchedulerParamsInit
